content.comment_body: Hello Everyone! I'm unsure how to create a Ladder Diagram using [product_name]. I have some references, but I need help with tasks like repeating an output on another line or resetting and setting one output. Could someone assist? Thanks!

Hello, I highly recommend using Function Block Diagram (FBD) instead of Ladder Logic Diagram (LLD). Most [product_name] users work with FBD because it's more straightforward, and you can find a free training on the [company_name] [product_name] website. Here is an example for LLD. Hope this is helpful.
